candidates.rationale: This statement accesses 'page' variable which is not defined within this scope. Without proper validation of the 'page' pointer before passing to page_pool_put_full_page, this could lead to use-after-free or invalid memory access vulnerabilities if 'page' contains stale or corrupted data.
Standard skb cleanup operation. Could be vulnerable if there's a double-free scenario where this function is called multiple times on the same skb without proper NULL checking between calls.

vuln_statements.explanation: This statement passes an unvalidated 'page' pointer to page_pool_put_full_page without proper scope validation. The 'page' variable may contain stale or corrupted data if not properly initialized or checked before use, leading to use-after-free or invalid memory access vulnerabilities when the function dereferences the potentially invalid page pointer.

    net: airoha: Fix page recycling in airoha_qdma_rx_process()
    
    Do not recycle the page twice in airoha_qdma_rx_process routine in case
    of error. Just run dev_kfree_skb() if the skb has been allocated and marked
    for recycling. Run page_pool_put_full_page() directly if the skb has not
    been allocated yet.
